description: This is a test file for the authentication API of a backend service, written with Jest using the 'supertest' library to simulate HTTP requests. It contains tests for signup, login, profile retrieval, and authentication-related endpoints.

methods.name: POST /auth/signup creates a user and returns token
methods.description: Tests the user registration process, ensuring a user is created and a token is returned, with validation of user details in response.

methods.name: POST /auth/signup validation errors
methods.description: Tests validation error handling during signup when invalid data is provided.

methods.name: POST /auth/login with email works
methods.description: Tests login functionality using email, expecting a token and user info.

methods.name: POST /auth/login with username works
methods.description: Tests login with username, expecting a token.

methods.name: GET /auth/me requires JWT and returns profile
methods.description: Tests fetching the authenticated user's profile with a valid JWT token.

methods.name: GET /auth/me unauthorized without token
methods.description: Ensures unauthorized access is properly handled when JWT token is missing.

methods.name: GET /auth/ping returns ok with valid token
methods.description: Tests a protected endpoint that verifies token validity and returns user info.
